#nullable enable
using LoadReferenceData.Csv;
using LoadReferenceData.TestDoubles;
using Xunit;

namespace LoadReferenceData.Tests;

public class DepartmentCsvRowSourceTests
{
    [Fact]
    public async Task ReadAsync_ReadsEveryRow_FromTheSampleFile()
    {
        using var harness = new PackageHarness();
        var package = harness.Package();
        var source = package.FF_SRC_Department();

        var rows = new List<DepartmentCsvRow>();
        await foreach (var row in source.ReadAsync(CancellationToken.None)) rows.Add(row);

        Assert.Equal(2, rows.Count);
        var first = rows[0];
        Assert.Equal(7, first.DepartmentID);
        Assert.Equal("Sample", first.DepartmentCode);
        Assert.Equal("Sample", first.DepartmentName);
        Assert.Equal("Sample", first.CostCenter);
        Assert.Equal(7, first.HeadCount);
    }
}
